subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】dining hall 餐厅; grass 草坪; gym 体育馆; ago 以前; cycling 骑自行车运动; ice-skate 滑冰; badminton 羽毛球; different 不同的; active 活跃的
【重点句型】There was/were ... 过去有…… Before, I was ... 以前我是…… Now, I'm ... 现在我是…… Could you ...? 你（过去）能……吗？ I didn't ... before. 我以前不……
【A Let's talk】Wu Yifan: Our school was small before. Now it is big. There was no gym. Now there is a new gym. Mike: There was no dining hall either. Chen Jie: Now we have a big dining hall.
【Read and write】There was no gym in my school before. Now there is a new one. There was no library. Now there is a big library. Before, I was short and quiet. Now I am tall and active. Before, I couldn't ride a bike. Now I go cycling every day.
key_points: Before, I was ... 以前我是……
I didn't ... before. 我以前不……
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
